principle: One channel, one meaning. A state is told by arcLine + arcFill + beam + mark (never by colour or luminance alone); luminance and phase locking only reinforce. All ten coupling states differ in that signature. Colour never carries a state.

channels.class: SEMANTIC (checked by the model) | LEXICAL (name relation only) | NONE (no relation) — the only thing L0 shows
channels.arcLine: solid | dotted | open | broken — the line of the requirement arc
channels.arcFill: 0 | 0.5 | 1 — the filled fraction of the arc; equals the value of the published ranking formula
channels.beam: solid | thin | dotted | faint-dotted | broken | none — the coupling from capability to arc (shown on hover / focus / open job)
channels.phaseLocked: true: the beam pulses in phase with its capability (semantic couplings that carry value); false: no synchrony
channels.mark: none | double | counterTick | alias | constituent — a small glyph on the arc that separates siblings of one class

honesty.DIFFERENT: judged different by the model — an explicit counter-mark; it is not 'unknown'
honesty.UNCLEAR: the model could not tell — a broken arc and beam; it is not 'different'
honesty.NONE: no relation was found — an open arc; it says 'not evidenced', never 'not present'
honesty.lexical: a name relation is weaker than a checked one by construction: dotted line, no phase lock, at most half fill

runStateRules.pendingBreath: While the run is RUNNING and fewer roles are evaluated than planned (budget), arcs of source LEXICAL or NONE breathe slowly: 'being worked on'. It is a field-level mark; which role is next is not in the ranking.
runStateRules.frozen: STALLED freezes every breath and motion; a still sentence stands beside the field. Never an alarm.
runStateRules.stalledWithResumePending: STALLED can come with resumePending=true (interrupted, inside the window): the field stays frozen, no pulse; the still sentence says the run is taken up again.
runStateRules.resumePulse: One quiet pulse at the field's edge while resumePending; no repeat faster than 6 s.
runStateRules.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing breathes, pulses or travels; pending is shown by a static dashed outline.

timeMovement.rule: A body moves only when new evidence changes its tier or fit, once per knowledge step, in under 900 ms, with a trail to its previous position; several changes of one read are one movement.
timeMovement.forbidden: No movement for decoration; no movement caused by a re-read that changed nothing.
